headline: Alabama's Largest County Faces Bankruptcy Without State Help
snippet: County slashed expenses, cut 700+ jobs. Legislature repeatedly failed to authorize replacement taxes.

headline: Tax for Bankrupt Alabama County Fails in State House
snippet: House refused to let bankrupt Jefferson County raise taxes on last day of session.

headline: Jefferson County Bankruptcy Fallout
snippet: Largest municipal bankruptcy in US history, $3.14B sewer debt. Emerged December 2013.
